一級準尉

NONE: › a written promise from a company to repair or replace a product that develops a fault within a particular period of time, or to do a piece of work again if it is not satisfactory
（商品的）保用單，保用卡

example: The warranty covers the car mechanically for a year, with unlimited mileage.
保用單承諾對汽車的機械部件保修一年，不限里程。
Synonym
guarantee

NONE: › also rabbit warren a series of connecting underground passages and holes in which rabbits live
（地下交錯相連的）兔子洞窟
› mainly disapproving a very crowded and confusing building or part of a city in which it is easy to get lost
擁擠且易使人迷路的建築物（或城區）

example: We wandered through the warren of old streets.
我們漫步在縱橫交錯的老街上。

NONE: › Warring countries or groups of people are at war with each other.
交戰的；敵對的；衝突的
› Warring groups disagree and argue strongly with each other.
相互敌对的派系

example: The Party, he said, had disintegrated into warring factions.
他說黨已經分裂成相互敵對的派系了。

NONE: C1 a soldier, usually one who has both experience and skill in fighting, especially in the past
（尤指舊時的）武士，勇士

example: a Samurai warrior
日本武士
a warrior king/nation
尚武的國王／好戰的民族

NONE: › a ship supplied with guns, for use in war
戰艦，軍艦
› a small, hard lump (= a raised area) that grows on the skin, often on the face and hands
（常見於面部和手上的）疣，肉贅
› an African wild pig with a large head, tusks, and little raised areas on the male's face that look like warts
（產於非洲的）疣豬
› a period of time during which a war is being fought
戰時

example: In wartime, food is often scarce.
在戰時，食品經常短缺。
The film is set in wartime England.
這部電影的背景是戰時的英格蘭。
Opposite
peacetime

NONE: › describing or including all the bad qualities in a person's character, with no attempt to hide them
不隱瞞缺點的；不遮醜的

example: He tried to paint the president as he really was, warts and all.
他試圖真實地刻畫總統，絲毫不掩飾其缺點。

NONE: › having warts
長瘤的，長疣的
C2 not completely trusting or certain about something or someone
謹慎的；小心翼翼的

example: I'm a little wary of/about giving people my address when I don't know them very well.
如果不是太熟的話，我不會輕易告訴別人我的地址。
